# howler-audio-manager

> H5/Web audio management library built on howler.js: enum-driven preset sound effects, dual caching (effect cache + URL audio cache), singleton dynamic URL playback, overlap prevention, preload/preheat support, and a dual-layer event system that leaves no memory leaks.

This is a TypeScript library published as `@jswork/howler-audio-manager`. Business code supplies its own sound enum (generic `AudioManager<K>`); the library never hardcodes business keys or URLs. `howler` is a peer dependency. Tests run with `bun test` (Howler is mocked), and packages are built with tsup into ESM, CommonJS, and UMD formats.
